title: Assemble Your Squad. Trade Together. Rise Through the Ranks.
summary: Build your trader squad, compete and win exciting rewards on Squad Wars: Mudrex Edition. August 27 - September 10
body_markdown:
## **Introducing Squad Wars: Mudrex Edition**


Some traders go it alone. Others build a squad.


For the next few weeks, Mudrex is turning Futures trading into a team sport. Refer your friends, help them make their first move in the markets, and watch your squad’s combined trading power carry you up a galaxy-wide leaderboard, while your recruits unlock rewards of their own.


Welcome to **Squad Wars: Mudrex Edition** .


From **August 27 to September 10** , refer, trade, and climb the ranks with your squad.


## **What Is Squad Wars?**


Squad Wars runs on referrals and Futures trading volume, and it rewards both sides of the squad:


- **New recruits** get rewarded for how much they trade.
- **Referrers** get rewarded for how much their whole squad trades, combined.


Here’s how to get in on it:


1. **Share your referral link.** Bring new traders onto Mudrex.
2. **Get them trading.** A referral becomes “successful” once your recruit completes a minimum of 3 Futures trades during the event period.
3. **Build combined volume.** The more your squad trades together, the higher you climb, and the more your recruits unlock individually.


## **Two Ways to Win**


### **1. Milestone Rewards: For New Recruits**


If you sign up on Mudrex through a referral link during the event, every bit of Futures trading volume you generate brings you closer to a guaranteed reward. These rewards are based on your own individual Futures trading volume, so there’s no need to rely on anyone else’s trades.

### **2. Leaderboard Rewards: For Squad Leaders**


Build your squad and climb the leaderboard.


Your leaderboard rank is based on the **combined Futures trading volume of the traders you’ve referred** , not your own trading volume. Get even one person to join and trade, and you’re on the board.

## **Both Tracks Run at the Same Time**


Here’s the part that makes Squad Wars different: your recruits’ trades count twice.


Say you refer 10 traders, and each of them generates ₹50 Cr in Futures trading volume during the event:


- Each of those 10 traders independently qualifies for their own **Milestone Reward** , based on their own ₹50 Cr.
- At the same time, their combined ₹500 Cr adds to **your leaderboard ranking** as the referrer.


Same trades, two reward tracks. Everybody in the squad wins on their own terms.


## **How to Join**


There’s no separate registration for Squad Wars.


- **Existing traders:** Share your referral link and start building your squad.
- **New traders:** Sign up using a referral link, then start trading Futures. Don’t have an invite? Sign up anyway, share your referral link, and build your squad.


Track your squad’s progress, milestone status, and leaderboard rank right from the Mudrex app.


## **Event Duration**


**Starts** **Ends**


August 27 September 10


Only eligible referrals and Futures trades made during this window will count.


## **When Do Rewards Get Credited?**


All rewards, both Milestone Rewards for new recruits and Leaderboard Rewards for referrers, will be credited within 72 hours after the event ends on September 10.


## **FAQs**


**What counts as a “successful” referral?**


A referred user is counted as a successful referral once they complete a minimum of 3 Futures trades during the event period.


**Who gets the Milestone Reward, me or my referrer?**


Milestone Rewards go to the referred user, based on their own individual Futures trading volume.


**Does my own trading volume count toward my leaderboard rank as a referrer?**


No. Only the combined Futures trading volume generated by the traders you’ve referred counts toward your leaderboard rank.


**Can the same trade count for both a Milestone Reward and a Leaderboard Reward?**


Yes. A referred user’s trading volume counts toward their own Milestone Reward and their referrer’s leaderboard ranking, independently.


**When will rewards be credited?**


All rewards will be credited within 72 hours after the event ends on September 10.


## **Terms & Conditions**


- The event runs from August 27 to September 10.
- The event is open to eligible Mudrex users during the event period.
- A successful referral is a referred user who completes a minimum of 3 Futures trades during the event period.
- Only users who sign up through a valid referral during the event period are eligible for Milestone Rewards.
- Milestone Rewards are based on the referred user’s own Futures trading volume generated during the event period.
- Existing Mudrex users can participate as referrers and compete for Leaderboard Rewards.
- Leaderboard rankings are based only on the combined Futures trading volume generated by eligible referrals; a referrer’s own trading volume is not included.
- Mudrex affiliate partners are not eligible to participate in this event.
- Trading volume generated through activity deemed fraudulent, abusive, manipulative, or otherwise in violation of Mudrex policies may be excluded from event calculations.
- Leaderboard rankings **at the end of the event** will be considered for reward levels.
- Rewards will be credited within 72 hours after the event ends, subject to verification and eligibility validation by Mudrex.
- Mudrex reserves the right to disqualify participants engaging in fraudulent or abusive activity.
- Mudrex reserves the right to modify, suspend, or terminate the event or its rewards at its discretion.
- All decisions regarding eligibility, trading volume calculations, and reward distribution are final and binding.


## **The Galaxy Is Waiting**


Whether you’re recruiting a squad or joining one, Squad Wars rewards every trade you make.


Open the Mudrex app, share your link or use one, and start trading.


*May the trades be with you.*
